data.title: Operating Costs Statement 2024 (Betriebskostenabrechnung)
data.summary: Hausverwaltung Exempeldreisam, acting as property manager, sent Simone Musterbreisgau the statement of operating and heating costs for her apartment at Kaiser-Joseph-Weg 44 for the period 1 January to 31 December 2024. After deducting her advance payments, a balance of €186.60 is due by 15 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is your landlord's annual settlement (Betriebskostenabrechnung) of running costs such as water, waste, cleaning, insurance and heating for your rented apartment for 2024. Your share was calculated by living area and, for heating, by consumption. Because your advance payments were lower than your actual share, you owe an extra €186.60. Pay this amount to the stated account by 15 December 2026. If you think an item is wrong, you can ask to inspect the supporting receipts (Belege) by appointment before paying; if you have doubts about the calculation, it may help to get advice from a tenants' association (Mieterverein).
